central_model: recurrent modular reactivation of a conserved regeneration-resilience toolkit
purpose: Convert species-level module recurrence into an explicit evolutionary mechanism model for underground-organ diversification.
core_interpretation: Morphologically distinct underground organs may have evolved repeatedly through recurrent recruitment, regulatory redeployment, and network-level convergence of conserved regeneration, resilience, developmental-state, regulatory, and structural-remodeling modules.
claim_calibration: The model is hypothesis-generating. It supports candidate module-level evolutionary signals but does not prove causal function, organ-level homology, or definitive underground-organ origins.
